ticket: R2 of plans/aws_redeployment_tickets.md (settles OD7 of R0)
supersedes: aws-redeployment-operator-decisions_2026-10-21, decision OD7 only (deferred to R2). Every other decision there stands as revised by aws-redeployment-od1-region-r1_2026-10-21 and aws-redeployment-od11-admin-identity-r2_2026-10-21.
authority: Agent-authored under CLAUDE.md, recording decisions the operator gave in session on 2026-10-21 on measurements made in R2. Execution aid for infrastructure work (CLAUDE.md §10.2). Closes no gate, amends no constitutional rule and changes no code pin.
decided_by: the operator, in session on 2026-10-21: A3 Sonnet 4.6 / A5 Opus 4.6, assessor Sonnet 4.6, global. profiles excluded and denied in R5 (answers to the agent's questions); orchestrator Opus 4.6 as an interim choice with Opus 5 as the target, after asking whether Opus 5 was possible ('mehet', 21:02 UTC)
decision: The host calls Bedrock in eu-north-1 through two eu. system-defined inference profiles: eu.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1 (orchestrator and drafter; AN12 A5) and eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (AN12 A3; assessor). global. profiles are excluded and denied. Opus 4.6 is the orchestrator for now because no newer Opus answers for this account; Opus 5 (or newer) is the target once the account can call it.
why: OD7 was deferred until R2 showed which models this account can call. R2 found that only the 4.6 generation and older answer, with request-per-minute quotas cut to 5-10.

findings.finding: From eu-north-1 through eu. profiles, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6 and (in R1) Haiku 4.5 return the fixed string OK. Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Sonnet 5.5, Sonnet 5 and Haiku 5.5 are refused with AccessDeniedException 'anthropic.claude-<model> is not available for this account ... contact AWS Sales', although get-foundation-model-availability reports each AUTHORIZED.

Applied cross-Region requests per minute: Opus 4.6 5 (L-11DFF789), Sonnet 4.6 10 (L-00FF3314), Haiku 4.5 10 (L-CCA5DF70), against a default of 10,000; tokens per minute at default: Opus 4.6 3,000,000 (L-0AD9BBE8), Sonnet 4.6 6,000,000 (L-15B8E632), Haiku 4.5 5,000,000 (L-58BE175A). All adjustable.

The refusals are an account-level model allow-list, not an SCP or a missing use-case form: the refused models have no cross-Region quota line in this account, while Haiku 4.5, Opus 4.5, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.5 and Sonnet 4.6 do. Whether the OD10 upgrade, a support case or a quota request lifts it is unknown.
findings.basis: docs/infrastructure_security/evidence_v2/R2/R2_08_quotas-applied.json (RUNLOG step 08d); the error text names the account and AWS Sales, not a policy.

findings.finding: A successful first call creates the model's Marketplace agreement (NOT_AVAILABLE to AVAILABLE); a refused call creates none.

Each chosen eu. profile is SYSTEM_DEFINED, ARN arn:aws:bedrock:eu-north-1:797661577394:inference-profile/<id>, and routes to the foundation model in eu-north-1, eu-west-3, eu-south-1, eu-south-2, eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Bedrock model invocation logging in eu-north-1 reads empty after the calls.

decisions.question: Orchestrator model on the host (ORCHESTRATOR_TRANSPORT_MODEL; the drafter)
decisions.answer: eu.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1, as an interim choice. Target: eu.anthropic.claude-opus-5 or newer, once this account can call it.
decisions.reason: The operator wanted Opus 5; it is refused for this account (F-R2-1, R2_14_converse-opus-5.json). Opus 4.6 is the newest Opus that answers.
decisions.consequence: R8 stores ORCHESTRATOR_TRANSPORT_MODEL=eu.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1. At 5 requests per minute (F-R2-2) sequential work fits; parallel DAG work will be throttled. Switching to the target model needs a short R2 re-check (one Converse call and its quota lines), then R5's model list, R11's endpoint policy and the secret value change; R3 keeps the model list a parameter.

decisions.question: AN12 A3 and A5 models (must differ)
decisions.reason: Two distinct models that answer; the heavier A5 stage gets the stronger model.
decisions.consequence: R9e rewrites the AN12 runbook's region and id lines for eu-north-1 and these ids; R15 passes them as --a3-model / --a5-model.

decisions.question: Assessor model (must differ from the drafter in every id form, AN1c)
decisions.reason: It names a different model from the Opus 4.6 drafter in every id form, and from the target Opus 5 as well, so it survives the orchestrator switch.
decisions.consequence: The AN1c guard must know the host's drafter model (Opus 4.6, from ORCHESTRATOR_TRANSPORT_MODEL), not only the CLI pin claude-opus-4-8; R9e checks this. The assessor version tag names bedrock-converse and eu-north-1.

decisions.question: global. inference profiles
decisions.answer: Excluded, and denied in R5's explicit deny.
decisions.reason: global. profiles may route outside the EU; OD1-r1 chose EU processing.
decisions.consequence: Fable 5 and 5.1 (offered here only as global.) are unavailable to the host. DC-16's approved Regions are eu-north-1 plus the five routed EU Regions.

decisions.question: Bedrock resources the host may invoke (input to R5 invoke policy and R11 endpoint policy, F2)
decisions.reason: Cross-Region inference needs the profile ARN and the foundation-model ARN in every Region the profile routes to (F2, F-R2-5).
decisions.consequence: Haiku 4.5 answers but is not in the set; it is not allowed unless a later record adds it.

known_gaps.gap: Whether a support case (Account and billing), a quota request or the OD10 upgrade makes Opus 5 or newer callable, and lifts the 5-10 RPM cut. Operator's to pursue; input to OD10.
Whether the Converse backend's retry handles throttling at 5 RPM without failing a run; R9e / R15 to show.
DC-36 is closed only when the same models answer from the host through PrivateLink (R11).

privacy.claim: No secret value, credential, prompt text or proposal content. The only model output recorded is the fixed string OK.
